verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local, on-device inference engine for MoE models: it streams weights from SSD and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on localhost. It has no hosted production environment or production data, so a sandbox-versus-production story is a category error for this kind of product. The adjacent items do not count as a sandbox: unit tests that run without real weights are a developer test suite, and the read-only base model with swappable adapters is a model-management feature.
